opinions.text: Ct. App. D. C. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 818.] Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of the position presently asserted by the respondent in his motion to dismiss filed October 27, 1980; the opposition filed thereto by petitioner on November 6, 1980; and the reply filed thereto by respondent on November 13, 1980.
